_doc: How often the company wakes. Source of truth for company/tools/cadence.js (copied to company/work/ops/cadence.json at founding). dispatcherTickMin = the dispatcher timer interval (systemd OnUnitActiveSec); defaultCooldownMin = rest between two dispatcher wakes of one seat when the seat sets no cooldownMin; maxPerTick = most loops the dispatcher starts in one tick. seats.<stationId> may set loopEvery (minutes or a 5-field cron: the seat's own loop routine schedule), cooldownMin, priority, wakeOnInbox, wakeOnOwnerMessage; `cadence.js apply` writes them into loops.json and the station. Env DISPATCH_COOLDOWN_MIN / DISPATCH_MAX_PER_TICK still override at run time. Changes are governed by the 'schedules' category (co.gate).
